subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is Qin Xixi, whose identity, face, hairstyle, makeup and outfit come from <Picture 1>: a strikingly beautiful ~23-year-old young woman with long black hair braided at the ends and wispy front bangs, a thin pink hairband, warm-brown eye makeup with slightly swollen tired eyelids, fair smooth skin, pink lips, dressed in a pink floral-knit cropped vest (with a three-dimensional pink rose decoration at the chest) over a camisole top, light-blue flared jeans, and white canvas shoes, with light-pink nail polish and a slender figure. <Picture 1> supplies identity reference only; its white-background, multi-view layout, dividing lines, and borders are not inherited.

<Subject 2> is Jiang Gui's symbolized presence within the phone screen, whose face, hairstyle and outfit come from <Picture 2>: a sharp-featured handsome young man with slightly messy short black hair, deep eyes, and a tailored black long coat.

<Subject 3> is Qin Xixi's old smartphone, generated as text-only prop: a 6.1-inch old-model phone in a faded-pink case with hairline screen scratches; the screen briefly lights up to reveal <Subject 2>'s small greyscale WeChat avatar and a long column of sent-but-unread grey bubbles on the left.

<Subject 4> is the morning urban main road environment, generated as text-only background: a four-lane two-way road with plane trees along both sides showing half-yellow half-green early-autumn leaves, modern glass-curtain office buildings, a convenience store rolling up its shutter, traffic lights, and a white pedestrian crosswalk.

<Subject 5> is the morning commuter crowd (background only), generated as text-only: 8–12 nameless urban passers-by in varied outfits (a suited man on his phone, a mother with a child, a couple, a delivery rider, an elderly jogger); natural walking motion; no eye contact with <Subject 1>; mild motion blur to set <Subject 1> apart.

summary:
[reference generation] On <Subject 4>, <Subject 1> walks slowly in the morning commuter stream, surrounded by <Subject 5> who neither look at her nor stop for her; she stares at her own clenched right fist where her nails dig half-moon red marks into her palm. <Subject 3> in her pocket briefly lights up, showing <Subject 2>'s greyscale avatar. She looks like a puppet the whole world has missed.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 3], and [Shot 4]): fully_preserved - the face, hairstyle, pink hairband, warm-brown eye makeup with slightly swollen eyelids, fair skin, pink lips, pink floral knit cropped vest with rose, camisole, light-blue flared jeans, white canvas shoes, light-pink nail polish, and slender figure from <Picture 1> remain exact; only the described emotional states (vacant stare, trembling fist) change.

<Subject 2> (appears only inside the pocket-screen flash in [Shot 3]): fully_preserved - the face, slightly messy short black hair, deep eyes, and tailored black long coat from <Picture 2> remain exact as the small greyscale avatar; <Subject 2> never appears as a living person.

<Subject 3> (appears only as the pocket-screen flash in [Shot 3]): fully_preserved - the 6.1-inch screen, faded-pink case, hairline scratches, and the column of unread sent grey bubbles remain recognizable in the brief lit-up flash.

<Subject 4> (appears in [Shot 1] and [Shot 3]): fully_preserved - the four-lane two-way road, plane trees with half-yellow half-green leaves, glass-curtain office buildings, rolling-shutter convenience store, traffic lights, and white crosswalk remain recognizable across scale changes.

<Subject 5> (appears in [Shot 1] and [Shot 3], background only): fully_preserved - the 8–12 nameless passers-by in varied outfits, natural walking motion, and mild motion blur remain recognizable as a flowing crowd.

detailed_description:
The target video uses a premium semi-realistic Chinese urban cinematic style rendered as believable live action, with realistic skin texture, individual hair strands, knit and denim fabric weight and folds that respond to physics, motivated directional light, soft natural shadow falloff, 35–50 mm lens rendering, moderate depth of field, restrained contrast, and a neutral cinematic grade. The setting is integrated with the characters under one consistent realistic layer; no painterly, cartoon, anime, plastic-CG, or collage-style separation is allowed. The scene uses a cool overcast morning with low saturation and visible film grain; <Subject 1>'s pink knit vest becomes the only warm color in an otherwise grey-blue street.

[Shot 1] Frontal medium close-up (shoulders up) of <Subject 1> walking directly toward the camera. <Subject 5> flow as a softly motion-blurred stream behind her. Her face is expressionless, eyes vacant, lips pressed into a line, jaw tight; her fair skin looks washed out under the cool light, and even the pink knit vest seems desaturated.

[Shot 2] At 00:05.000, hard cut to <Subject 1>'s subjective point-of-view shot. The frame is filled by her right hand: five fingers clenched into a fist, knuckles pale; fingernails dig half-moon red marks into her palm edge; the fist trembles faintly.

[Shot 3] At 00:09.000, hard cut to a wide medium shot of <Subject 1>'s back amid <Subject 5>. She enters from the left and exits to the right while the crowd layers thickly around her; not one person turns to look back. As she exits, <Subject 3> in her pocket briefly lights up, revealing <Subject 2>'s small greyscale WeChat avatar above a column of unread sent bubbles.

[Shot 4] At 00:13.000, hard cut to a low-angle close-up of <Subject 1>'s feet. Her white canvas shoes step one at a time on fallen plane-tree leaves; the toe of her right shoe crushes a half-yellow half-green leaf that silently folds under the sole; the frame freezes on her toe one inch from another leaf, not moving forward.

overall_soundscape:
Dense urban hum—traffic, voices, e-bike horns compressed into a blurred drone; a barely audible sniffle; the faint crunch of a leaf underfoot; a faint phone vibration from inside the pocket.
